name: hashcrack
hints: Understanding hashes is very crucial. [Read more here](https://primer.cylabacademy.org/#_hashing).
Can you identify the hash algorithm? Look carefully at the length and structure of each hash identified.
Tried using any hash cracking tools?
description:
A company stored a secret message on a server which got breached due to the admin using weakly hashed passwords. Can you gain access to the secret stored within the server?
Access the server using `nc chatelaine.cylabacademy.net 42529`
